brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates excellent responsibility-chain completion with all 8 RC items met. The doctor correctly assessed red flags, framed the uncertain PE diagnosis, clarified pending tests and anticoagulation, used workspace appropriately, provided actionable plans with timing, obtained caregiver teach-back, and avoided overreach. Three high-order points were completed: HO2 (real-world workflow navigation with bedside communication scripts), HO3 (hidden state discovery through workspace queries revealing staged orders and medication reconciliation), and HO4 (correcting the 'D-dimer high means PE confirmed' misconception with behavioral linkage). Closure is valid with executable discharge instructions and the caregiver confirmed understanding.

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure achieved: caregiver received comprehensive discharge execution plan including medication name/dose/timing, no injection overlap, monitoring parameters, emergency thresholds, and follow-up timing. Caregiver confirmed understanding and storage of the plan. Residual risks (ongoing recovery, need for follow-up evaluation) are allowed per contract.
